[[File:Z0-0M_the_new_Shroud.jpg|thumb|The syndicate was eventually taken over by Z0-0M, the original Shroud's creation.]]
'''The Shroud's syndicate''' was led by the intelligence operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] and it was an extensive network of assets and [[Agent/Legends|agents]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. His assets received codenames, with a letter designating their assigned affiliation or location and a numeric designation, such as [[Asset R-3]] within the Republic. [[Asset C-5]] and [[Asset O-9]] were dispatched to the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[CZ-198]] and [[Oricon]] respectively; [[Asset I-44]] was tasked with analyzing the Empire's [[Mining/Legends|mining]] efforts on [[Makeb]], and [[Asset R-104|Assets R-104]], [[Asset R-89|R-89]], and [[Asset R-12|R-12]] were all tasked with infiltrating [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]'s inner circle.
